name: deterministic-finance-cad-mcp
description: Exact tools for bank statements (MT940, camt, BAI2, CODA), SEPA and NACHA ACH payment files, and DXF laser-cut quotes.
long_description: Rule-based APIs instead of LLM guesswork: reconcile bank statements and convert them to CSV, hledger, beancount, camt.053 or DATEV; generate and validate SEPA pain.001/pain.008 and NACHA ACH files; measure and price DXF parts for laser cutting. Needs a free RapidAPI key.

rapidapi_key.title: RapidAPI key
rapidapi_key.description: Free key from rapidapi.com; subscribe to the free plans of the SSYkolos APIs.
